chunks: And it was said to him (peace be upon him):
With what did you overpower your adversaries? He answered: Whenever I confronted a person he helped me against himself.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali overcome his adversaries according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this narration from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) attributes his superiority over peers to his mastery of *al-ghabtah* (competitive excellence) through psychological insight, specifically by causing each individual to become their own adversary. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of *adab al-nafs* (discipline of the self), where internalizing one's flaws leads to external victory, a concept deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition of knowing the self to know the Lord.
